reserveReview.compositionBasis: Complete implementation-defined local gross token inventory across five chain-specific pinned blocks on 2026-10-15. Ethereum sUSDS uses native USDS conversion; L2 sUSDS uses local PSM3 USDC conversion; residual USDC and USDS are valued at accounting par, with no stress/fee deduction.
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: All nonzero holdings in the five implementation-defined local inventories are identified. Ultimate Sky reserve custody, enforceable priority and independent encumbrance remain upstream/unestablished. Idle USDC and Ethereum USDS dust are excluded from holder totalAssets accounting and have no direct holder recovery horizon. L2 bridged sUSDS realization into native USDS depends on separate bridge and local PSM paths; no immediate USDC or final cash guarantee is inferred.
